method.scope: All 61 sources in _quarto-html.yml at baseline and current; excludes generated outputs, unconfigured sources, and citations outside .reference blocks.
method.entry_normalization: Whitespace, case, final full stop, typographicquotes/dashes, italic/code markup and punctuation spacing normalized; author/date/title/content/URLs otherwise retained.
method.work_identity: Author list, year, and title prefix through the first sentence break; Unicode accents, spacing, punctuation and URLs normalized. Changed metadata variants were manually reviewed. This does not resolve author identities or verify scientific claims.
method.order: Independent regular-expression extraction of surname/initial pairs, or a corporate-name fallback, then year/suffix and title with initial A/An/The ignored. Names are compared letter-by-letter after accent/punctuation removal; author-list tuple prefixes put shorter lists first. This checks coauthor-aware alphabetization, not exhaustive APA style compliance.
method.anchors: Explicit #identifiers inside Quarto attribute braces and literal HTML id attributes compared per file. Lost legacy URLs would be flagged even if the identifier exists elsewhere. Automatic heading slugs are not included.
method.snapshot: Captured source SHA-256 hashes; reread after audit to detect concurrent changes. Later source edits may require a targeted recheck.

reproduction.note: This embedded independent audit script regenerates the core JSON record; the sorting-fix provenance and reproduction fields are added after that run.

final_link_integration_refresh.limits: Compared reference counts, normalized entries/work identities, locations, metadata variants, order and review hashes with the previous audit. Previous full source contents were not retained, so hash changes alone do not prove a byte-level exclusion of every possible non-reference prose change. Current raw ordered-reference-block hashes are recorded for future refreshes.
